name: Alistar
rationale: Ever since the loss of Mobility Boots / Symbiotic Soles, Alistar has felt constrained in his gameplay, to the point he's failing to compete in the current meta even though it favors roaming supports - a space we expect him to excel in.

lines.raw: Base movement speed increased to 335 from 330.

name: Bel'Veth
rationale: This patch, we're launching a set of Bel'Veth changes that are aimed at making her gameplay pattern a bit less focused around her early game, in order to allow her to fulfill her fantasy as a late game scaling champion. The major changes here are making her Q at early levels function more like a regular dueling ability in order to reduce just how heavily she can put certain champions behind with early invades. Historically, this Q tuning has caused us to repeatedly balance around her very early strength at a loss to many of her other more core functions. While we acknowledge that there's a subset of Bel'Veth players who love this capability, broadly, we think it's paying too many tradeoffs for the rest of her audience. We are looking to move some of her early game power to her mid and late game by leaning more on her evolution fantasy and her stacking mechanic. We believe that high moments like having form until death when you have gotten enough stacks feels like a transformative yet exciting moment that lines up a bit more with her kit expectations.

rationale: Despite the recent buff, Kai’sa remains weaker than expected, especially late game for a marksman who is supposed to hyperscale to make up for her short range. We’re tapping up her scaling to help her output as she nears her final form.

name: Riven
rationale: Endless Hunger's addition to the game has given Riven an extremely potent new tool that fits her play pattern almost perfectly. While we feel we've gotten it into a fairly good spot among most users, Riven is notably overperforming. Targeting her R’s AD scaling (heavy synergy with Endless Hunger haste, mid quest scaling) will impact all her spells and how unstoppable her snowballing can feel, while still leaving a lot of room for her high moments.

Bonus AD ratio reduced to 55% bonus AD from 60%.

name: Sylas
rationale: After his buff in 26.12, it was clear that we moderately overshot our target. We’re pulling back the chains a tad to prevent him from bullying too hard.

lines.raw: First lash base damage reduced to 40 to 120 from 40 to 140.
First lash AP ratio reduced to 40% AP from 45% AP.

name: Volibear
rationale: Since our direct and systemic adjustments, the bear has been hibernating from dusk till dawn for a couple patches… we’re giving him more chances to gap close, especially for laners, without raising his already thrilling ceiling of spell chaining.

lines.raw: Cooldown reduced to 12 to 10 seconds from 14 to 10.

name: Zac
rationale: We believe that Zac brings unique gameplay and class diversity to the jungle. That said, his presence in the jungle has fallen quite a bit over the more recent patches. We believe giving him a bit more opportunity to execute on his distinct gank angles as well as a bit of durability in a team fight can help lift up our favorite secret weapon.

Cooldown reduced to 21 to 9 seconds from 22 to 10.

name: Bastionbreaker
rationale: The item has been near bottom pickrate since release, and the distance between it and the next least popular Lethality item is quite far. We’re making it both more accessible and slightly stronger on its less noticeable effect, because we find that lethality users putting more of their gold into utility and progressing the team game is healthy in the long term.

name: Terminus
rationale: Terminus is meant to be one of the premium capstone items for scaling On-Hit builds, but has been more of a mid game spike item than a true late game scaling option, leaving the on-hit space a bit sparse for options later on.

lines.raw: New Effect: Shadow on-hit damage now scales with 10% bonus AD and 10% AP.

name: Yun Tal Wildarrows
rationale: Yun Tal Wildarrows has fallen significantly over this year from its spot as the go-to scaling crit item. We believe the game continues to benefit from its function as a scaling option, so we are buffing it up to compete with the broader array of early crit items currently on offer.

rationale: Different statlines are much more accessible with items like Endless Hunger/Gluttonous Greaves/DHelm, and even though we love players shooting for creative builds to utilize JOAT, it definitely has room to be weaker both early and late while still giving a ton of bang for your buck.

rationale: We are continuing to monitor Azir, especially as players continue to pick up Press The Attack as his optimal keystone. For now however, we are going to give him a moderate buff to his laning to help him out.

rationale: Bel'Veth has come out with the scaling curve of Kayle and Aurelion Sol. Her power is rapidly growing across all skill brackets and given her early game is already quite weak, we've opted to make her late game a bit less sharp.

rationale: With roaming supports all the rage, Camille has been queen. We are simultaneously looking to nerf her support roaming power while keeping or (hopefully) actually buffing her top lane. This means trading the raw all in power behind her passive shield early game in favor of significantly lowered cooldowns for better repeatable trading.

name: Poppy
rationale: Poppy is meant to be a tank whose gameplay has leaned too far into early game snowball fighter, to the point she's choosing Hail of Blades and Sundered Sky over more tank runes and items. We're looking to shift power out of her early game AD fighter pattern and enable her tank pattern by significantly increasing her scaling with durability and giving her enough mana growth that sustained combat doesn't immediately run her out of resources.

Because his late game can be so potent, we're doubling down on his scaling archetype and making his laning phase even more difficult.

rationale: Speaking of a more diverse jungle Meta, we are adjusting the way jungle pets scales to help mage and tank junglers against the current AD fighter meta.

name: Berserker's Greaves
rationale: Berserker's Greaves have been sitting at a particularly low state of power for a while now, and with the state of AD champions in both bot and mid, we feel this is the right time to buff them.

lines.raw: Attack speed increased to 30% from 25%.

name: Black Cleaver
rationale: Black Cleaver has become a Smolder / Senna item more than a core AD fighter item. We are re-adding the Melee / Ranged split on the move speed effect to buy space to buff it for AD fighters without pushing it over the top for its ranged user base.

name: Chainlaced Crushers
rationale: We continue to feel that defensive boot optimizations in mid lane stifle action. Since we are looking to shift mage power back from bot lane to mid lane this patch, we are also taking the time to nerf down mid lane counter itemization against mages.

name: Eclipse
rationale: Eclipse has similarly fallen behind as an option for AD champions as a high ticket early AD item that isn't in the Lethality space. We feel it has clear space for a buff.

name: Runaan's Hurricane
rationale: Runaan's Hurricane has lost all of its core users over the course of the year as ADCs have moved to a wider variety of AS Crit itemization. We are buffing its unique effect and movespeed to help players capitalize on the positioning requirements of that unique effect.

name: Spellslinger's Shoes
rationale: Along with Chainlaced Crushers' change, we are buffing Spellslinger's Shoes to further affect mid vs bot mage balance.

lines.raw: Flat magic penetration increased to 20 from 18.

name: Sterak's Gage
rationale: Sterak's Gage has also lost its position as the premium juggernaut / diver teamfight item, with Guardian Angel taking its place. We think Sterak's is a much healthier fit for these champions to take.

lines.attribute: The Claws That Catch base AD ratio

name: Sundered Sky
rationale: Sundered Sky, on the other hand, has been the meta dominant AD fighter item for the last year. While we do find it exciting to see when players manage to chain its triggers through a teamfight and barely survive risky engages, we think it's a bit too performant when optimized to the point where it's healing for more than even lifesteal based items.

rationale: Tiamat has ended up in a state where even if you are buying a Hydra item, it's optimal NOT to purchase it until you have all the other components. That's pretty lame, yo.

name: Fleet Footwork
rationale: Fleet Footwork has been a relatively weaker and underutilized Precision keystone, and we feel like it has room to be a decent option for sustaining against harass past early laning and onwards.

name: Hail of Blades
rationale: Hail of Blades is currently contributing significantly to the extreme early game roaming meta with its super front loaded power skew. We are pushing its power back towards scaling to help soften this impact.

name: Aurelion Sol
rationale: Aurelion Sol has come out the loser of last patch's mage adjustments, so we are giving him a buff to help him out. In particular, we are buffing his W cooldown so he can use it a bit more freely rather than only when a reset is likely. This should also make it a bit more clear to players that W is typically the stronger second skill to max, rather than E.

name: Cho'Gath
rationale: Cho's early game has lost pizzazz with Hail of Blades and Hextech Rocketbelt nerfs, so we are making it up with a bit of early damage when he does get those autos off.

lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where the dash speed was slower than intended in certain cases.

name: Graves
rationale: Graves has had a number of indirect buffs over the last few patches and this has put him in a pretty strong spot. We are looking to soften a bit of his ability to snowball the game with high AD builds.

name: Irelia
rationale:
Irelia is one of League’s highest stakes snowballing dependant skirmishers, but we feel like even when ahead she is failing to scale into a real carry threat
Additionally, we are buffing some of her AP ratios to support wacky ARAM/Arena builds. We don’t expect this to make AP Irelia suddenly good for SR.

name: LeBlanc
rationale: With the previous version of Statikk Shiv that drove nerfing her AS ratios no longer in the game, we’re bringing these closer to a typical champion’s baseline. Simultaneously, having some room for power, we are giving her some AP ratio buffs to make sure she's still interested primarily in AP assassination builds.

name: Nasus
rationale: Nasus top has been able to benefit from the shift in his stacking paradigm. We are happy to see our favorite dog get his fill of treats, but want to make sure that we keep his power within reasonable bounds, therefore we are going to be tapping down some of Nasus' top specific strengths, like persistently lifestealing off of minions.

lines.raw: Life steal reduced to 10 to 20% from 12 to 24%.

name: Nocturne
rationale: Nocturne has been sitting in a pretty strong state across skill levels for a while. We are excited about the opportunities that open up when Nocturne unlocks his ult, but want to add a bit more personal risk to him accessing that high moment.

name: Qiyana
rationale: Qiyana's play has moved out of primarily mid to jungle. While we are happy to support her as a jungler, mid is where she’s been underwhelming recently.

name: Thresh
rationale: Thresh has been quietly sitting at a high winrate and picking up playrate over the year.

name: Trundle
rationale: Sometimes you just wanna club your opponents to death, and while Trundle has been a resilient utility pick for his pillar and ult, we feel his personal clubbing power has actually been a bit limp.

lines.raw: Bonus attack speed increased to 30 to 110% from 30 to 90%.

name: Vayne
rationale: We believe Vayne may need larger scope work in the future to help out her bot lane, but for now are prioritizing constraining her top lane power. These changes should impact her up there more than in bot lane.

name: Xerath
rationale: Xerath has rested slightly high in power both mid and bot, and after last patch's adjustments to mages has come out on top in mid lane compared to others. Given his extremely high ban rate in certain regions, he's due a light nerf.

name: Yasuo
rationale: While Yasuo has definitely been able to snowball and carry games, we believe that similar to Irelia, he is too reliant on snowballing rather than just being a proper scaling carry. We also want to encourage him to prioritize early crit strike builds over Blade of the Ruined King, so we are reducing his crit damage penalty which will simultaneously encourage this as well help him scale without significantly impacting his early game snowball.

lines.raw: Total critical strike damage reduction reduced to 5% from 10%.

name: Yone
rationale: Similar to Yasuo, Yone has also been an excessively snowball reliant carry, though less so. Bros stay together.

lines.raw: Total critical strike damage reduction reduced to 5% from 10%.

name: Stormrazor
rationale: Stormrazor almost had its time in the sun earlier this year, but has ended up remaining second fiddle.

lines.raw: Attack speed increased to 25% from 20%.

name: Sundered Sky
rationale: Last patch’s Sundered Sky nerf was a step in the right direction, but landed a bit under-target given all of the other moving pieces of that patch.

lines.raw: Health reduced to 400 from 450.
Attack damage reduced to 40 from 45.

lines.attribute: Tooltip now notes the correct slow resistance amount of 25% instead of 40%.
lines.raw: Undocumented / Bug Fix: Tooltip now notes the correct slow resistance amount of 25% instead of 40%.
Actual slow resistance unchanged.

name: Bard
rationale: Bard has been a meta staple for much of the year. Earlier we toned his damage down to what we think are reasonable levels, so this time we are going to target his durability which has also stood out as high given his mobility and long range ultimate utility.

lines.raw: Base armor reduced to 32 from 34.
Armor growth reduced to 4.7 from 5.

name: Cassiopeia
rationale: Cassio has always scaled with skill, but this year has propelled her to new heights of pro play dominance despite being weaker for average players. These adjustments should tap down her laning power, especially in pro where defensive purchases are valued more than raw AP, while giving her back some scaling power. It will still be critical to use empowered E's, but raising her floor lets us be a bit more flexible with tuning.

lines.raw: Movement speed bonus reduced to 5 to 36% from 6 to 40%.
Base damage reduced to 65 to 205 from 75 to 215.
AP ratio increased to 75% AP from 65% AP.
Initial base damage reduced to 50 to 118 from 52 to 120.
Initial AP ratio increased to 20% AP from 10% AP.
Poisoned AP ratio reduced to 45% AP from 55% AP.
Mana cost increased to 45 from 40.
Base damage reduced to 125 to 325 from 150 to 350.
AP ratio increased to 75% AP from 50% AP.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where the VFX may not play properly around different areas of the map.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where the VFX may not play properly around different areas of the map.

name: Ekko
rationale: As one of our assassins that offer opponents a wider mix of gameplay options, Ekko has found a slightly weak steady state since Dusk & Dawn's update mid year. We believe he has some room for power, especially in mid where he scales slightly worse, without buffing his Hail of Blades pattern.

lines.raw: Mana cost reduced to 40 to 80 from 50 to 90.
Return AP ratio increased to 70% AP from 60% AP.

name: Kassadin
rationale: Kassadin had a strong start to 2026 but hasn't regained his…footing…since our earlier nerfs. His Q should feel more punchy with his scaling, and we're aiming to provide more early agency through good Riftwalk usage without touching his late game fantasy.

lines.raw: AP ratio increased to 80% AP from 70% AP.
Base damage increased to 80 to 110 from 70 to 110.

name: Master Yi
rationale: Yi drew the short end of the stick on the Rageblade bugfix from earlier this year due to his double strike interactions. While the actual impact for most Rageblade users was minor (and we are compensating Rageblade as well for that this patch), he was impacted harder than the other users. He's also just been unable to scale as well as a melee carry compared to his normal power level, so we are also giving him a buff up.

lines.raw: Armor growth increased to 5 from 4.5.
Bonus movement speed increased to 40 to 60% from 35 to 55%.

name: Nautilus
rationale: Nautilus has been sitting near the top of the meta for the entire year, even before our work to bring other tank supports up in power, and we feel nerfing him will open up room for a more variety. That said, we know a lot of his value is in being able to lock down champions effectively, and that'll remain a core strength.

lines.raw: Base attack damage reduced to 58 from 61.
Base damage reduced to 85 to 245 from 85 to 265.

name: Seraphine
rationale: Seraphine bot has been a source of frustration for opponents for some time, despite a minor nerf a few patches ago. We are nerfing her E's rank up to target this head on, as support Seraphine usually maxes it last (which basically means she never has it maxed as a support.)

lines.raw: Cooldown increased to 11 seconds at all ranks from 11 to 9.

name: Syndra
rationale: Our MSI changes were effective at pulling her to the forefront of pro play for the first time in years, but unfortunately she's too performant in specific solo queue settings. Our data shows that W damage is a meaningfully larger share of damage in the tiers where she's stronger than desired, so this should help tap her down while still preserving her core fantasies. Her passive is also now better breakpointed to increase reliance on Lost Chapter in early-mid levels, nerfing her higher winrate builds that make do with less mana investment.

lines.old: 15+5*x for 5 / then +8*x for 5 / then +15*x for 5 / then +20*x for 3
lines.new: 16+4*x for 6 / then +6*x for 4 / then +15*x for 5 / then +20*x for 3
lines.raw: Splinter of Wrath mana restored reduced to 16+4*x for 6 / then +6*x for 4 / then +15*x for 5 / then +20*x for 3 from 15+5*x for 5 / then +8*x for 5 / then +15*x for 5 / then +20*x for 3.
Cooldown increased to 13 to 9 seconds from 12 to 8.

name: Viego
rationale: Viego's winrate has been on a downward trend recently, and his players have noticed and begun dropping him. He has a fair bit of room to bring up, both just generally and for the viability of his more bruisery alt build.

lines.raw: Attack damage growth increased to 4 from 3.5.

lines.attribute: Heal now also scales with 0.4% per 100 bonus health.
lines.raw: New Effect: Heal now also scales with 0.4% per 100 bonus health.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where when possessing Kled could result in an infinite looping sound effect.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where when possessing Kled could result in an infinite looping sound effect.

name: Zaahen
rationale: We're using a QoL change here as an opportunity to give Zaahen some love! This might read as a nerf, but Zaahen's Q lined up with his passive in such a way that it meant he always left his resurrection (and GA, Zilean R) with Q on CD, so now he's always happier. His Q2 is also a clean double of his Q1 base damage now.

lines.attribute: If the ability is active, it is now placed on cooldown immediately upon being put in resurrection.
lines.raw: New Effect: If the ability is active, it is now placed on cooldown immediately upon being put in resurrection.
Recast base damage increased to 30 to 150 from 25 to 125.

name: Zeri
rationale: Zeri has been slowly climbing in winrate with the recent Runaan's Hurricane and Yun Tal Wildarrows buffs. She now sits very high in winrate compared to her historical resting, which is worrying for a champ that is so skill intensive. As she has also begun showing up in pro, we expect she has a high chance of becoming meta dominant, so we are pulling some power out of her burst and waveclear.

lines.raw: AD ratio reduced to 100% AD from 120% AD.

name: Guinsoo's Rageblade
rationale: In light of the bugfix nerfing rageblade by a minor amount by pushing back when the first double hit triggers, we are compensating with a similarly minor QoL buff to help players get it stacked up and keep it stacked.

lines.raw: Seething Strike stack duration increased to 4 seconds from 3.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where maximum stacks of Void Corruption were higher than intended.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where maximum stacks of Void Corruption were higher than intended.

lines.attribute: Clones: Fixed a bug where clones would not receive Homeguards after running back to the fountain.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where clones would not receive Homeguards after running back to the fountain.

lines.attribute: Role Quests: Toplane Quest: Teleport cooldown
lines.raw: Teleport cooldown reduced to 390 seconds from 420.

lines.attribute: Role Quests: Toplane Quest: Unleashed Teleport cooldown is now reduced by 30 seconds.
lines.raw: New Effect: Unleashed Teleport cooldown is now reduced by 30 seconds.

name: Aatrox
rationale: We think The Darkin Blade has lost a fair bit of power with Sundered Sky nerfs that were aimed more at opening up the jungle meta, so we are giving him a bump so he remains a world-ending threat.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where the sweetspots use crit text instead of enhanced damage text.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where the sweetspots use crit text instead of enhanced damage text.
Cooldown reduced to 18 to 12 seconds from 20 to 12.
Heal health ratio increased to 1.3% per 100 bonus health from 1.1%.

name: Aphelios
rationale: Aphelios has been kiting the spotlight for a while now, even though he's a hypercarry in an enchanter meta that should favor him, so we're looking to give him a little boost to encourage him to get out of his comfort zone.

lines.raw: Base damage increased to 80 to 170 from 70 to 160.
Attack healing increased to 2 to 8% from 2 to 7.1%.
Ability healing increased to 5 to 20% from 5 to 17.75%.
Slow decay floor increased to 15% from 10%.
Cooldown reduced to 8 to 5 seconds from 9 to 6.
Starting AD ratio increased to 16% AD from 15% AD.

lines.attribute: Minimum AD ratio reached at 9 Chakrams instead of 8.
lines.raw: Minimum AD ratio reached at 9 Chakrams instead of 8.

name: Aurora
rationale: Despite not receiving any changes since last year, Aurora has fallen off as we've had to nerf Rocketbelt into a fairer state. We're giving our favorite Bryni a bit more power in her waveclear and outplay potential with her ultimate.

lines.raw: Base damage increased to 80 to 240 from 70 to 230.
Rift duration increased to 2.25 to 3.25 seconds from 2.5-0.75 to 4-0.75.

lines.attribute: No longer includes 0.75 seconds of expansion time in its calculation (which unintentionally reduced the defined duration of 2.5 to 4 seconds).
lines.raw: No longer includes 0.75 seconds of expansion time in its calculation (which unintentionally reduced the defined duration of 2.5 to 4 seconds).
Realm Hopper buff duration reduced to 3.25 to 4.25 seconds from 3.5 to 5.

lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where it would sometimes not trigger Shield Bash.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where it would count as two hits when triggering Bone Plating.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where it would count as two hits when triggering Bone Plating.

name: Draven
rationale: Since all bot laners received significantly increased gold income thanks to role quests, Draven's potential to gain a gold advantage through his Adoration stacks has lost some of its impact. We're giving him a helping hand (axe?) by tapping up his early game damage.

lines.raw: Base attack damage increased to 64 from 62.

name: Elise
rationale: This year started strong for AP junglers that could use Dusk and Dawn, but others like Elise have been in a weak spot for a while, so we are helping out our friendly neighborhood spider with clear speed and damage.

lines.raw: Base damage increased to 14 to 44 from 12 to 42.
Active bonus attack speed increased to 70 to 130% from 60 to 120%.

name: Fiora
rationale: Our Grand Duelist has room to shine a bit more when she succeeds after finding her opening, without giving her sharper 1v1 tools.

lines.raw: Health growth increased to 105 from 99.
Heal range increased to 600 from 550.
Base heal per tick increased to 20 to 32.5 from 18.75 to 31.25.
Bonus AD ratio per tick increased to 17.5% bonus AD from 15%.

name: Kha'Zix
rationale: Kha'Zix has been on the fringe of the meta now that the jungle is no longer dominated by Sundered Sky users. We are taking this opportunity to buff some of his weaker evolves to give him the flexibility to adapt and overcome.

lines.raw: Base damage increased to 22 to 141 from 17 to 136.
Slow duration increased to 2.25 seconds from 2.
Bonus range increased to 300 from 200.

name: Lillia
rationale: Lillia is on the edge of being viable at higher levels of play and we believe her current pattern requires her to get in danger's way, so we're helping her durability. We also want to give Lillia opportunities to really be a playmaker so we're making the enemies she lullabies a little extra sleepy.

lines.raw: Base armor increased to 24 from 22.
Sleep duration increased to 2.5 seconds from 2.

name: Lucian
rationale: Years ago, we added the Vigilance Passive so Lucian bot players didn't feel like their champ was being nerfed because of mid laners, which ended up being super effective. We think now is a good opportunity to adjust the tuning of the passive and strike a balance between both roles.

lines.raw: Vigilance base damage reduced to 5 from 15.
Vigilance AD ratio per tick reduced to 15% AD from 20% AD.
Base damage increased to 90 to 250 from 80 to 220.

name: Master Yi
rationale: Somewhat overdue, but because Duskblade was removed a while ago, we're removing the Ability Haste penalty we had to apply to his Q CDR mechanic. This should have minimal impact on Summoner's Rift, but we see you Mayhem and Arena!

lines.attribute: On-hit cooldown reduction is no longer reduced by ability haste.
lines.raw: Removed: On-hit cooldown reduction is no longer reduced by ability haste.

name: Nasus
rationale: Nasus is difficult to keep down these days, and part of that is how quickly getting his early stacks leads to more reliable stacking. These higher highs will be compensated with some lower lows through some more vulnerability early on with lower damage and lifesteal lane sustain values off of that, and a bit longer before he really comes online.

lines.raw: Base damage reduced to 30 to 110 from 40 to 120.

name: Nocturne
rationale: Nocturne has been a popular and powerful jungler in both pro and solo-queue for a while, so we're hitting the map presence and dueling power he benefits from through his ultimate.

lines.raw: Cooldown increased to 160 to 100 seconds from 140 to 90.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where he could unlock his camera during the ability.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where he could unlock his camera during the ability.

name: Poppy
rationale: Poppy's flex potential and jungle presence has been a bit problematic, suppressing many champions across the board as a strong counterpick. For this change, we're targeting her flexibility by reverting a previous buff to jungle clear.

lines.raw: Monster cap damage reduced to 70 to 210 from 85 to 225.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where it would not amp damage caused by Berserk targets.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where it would not amp damage caused by Berserk targets.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where he would not gain 20 Fury when it was cast immediately after Ruthless Predator.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where he would not gain 20 Fury when it was cast immediately after Ruthless Predator.

name: Rumble
rationale: At higher levels of play, we've seen Rumble continue to take over games, even after our changes earlier this year designed to hit his power in lane. Here, we're making some modifications to his passive that's much more elite-skewed, while giving Rumble in the Jungle some compensation.

lines.raw: Overheated bonus attack speed reduced to 30 to 100% from 50 to 130%.
Overheated monster cap damage increased to 90 to 175 from 65 to 150.

name: Ryze
rationale: Between strong itemization options and best-in-class skirmish and roam potential demonstrated by his most skilled players, it's high time we put some restraints on the archmage, while giving him some help with bad solo queue matchups.

lines.raw: Armor growth increased to 4.7 from 4.2.
Flux bonus damage reduced to 15 to 90% from 25 to 100%.
Mana cost increased to 40 to 80 from 35 to 75.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where the terrain was smaller than the hitbox.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where the terrain was smaller than the hitbox.

name: Vi
rationale: Vi has been a meta staple for the entire year, and now that Sundered Sky is in a better spot, we're going after her durability and early clear speed to make her a riskier pick who can still bring the pain if you are willing to build for it.

lines.raw: Base attack damage reduced to 61 from 63.
Attack damage growth increased to 3.9 from 3.5.
Health ratio reduced to 10% maximum health from 12%.

name: Volibear
rationale: This year we've been carefully buffing up AD Volibear, but he remains on the weak side even with his very unique AP build. We're tuning him up to help him out across both the fringe AD build and his core AP build.

lines.attribute: Attack speed AP ratio per stack
lines.raw: Attack speed AP ratio per stack increased to 4% per 100 AP from 3% per 100 AP.

lines.attribute: Maximum stacks attack speed AP ratio
lines.raw: Maximum stacks attack speed AP ratio increased to 4*5% per 100 AP from 3*5% per 100 AP.

lines.attribute: Lightning Claws damage now also scales with 20% bonus AD.
lines.raw: New Effect: Lightning Claws damage now also scales with 20% bonus AD.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where the warning VFX was not visible in very specific circumstances.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where the warning VFX was not visible in very specific circumstances.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where her basic attack resets would not extend Hail of Blades appropriately.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where her basic attack resets would not extend Hail of Blades appropriately.
Health reduced to 60 from 100.
Base health regeneration increased to 75% from 50%.
Health reduced to 0 from 30.
Base health regeneration increased to 50% from 25%.

name: Ambessa
rationale: Ambessa has been too reliable in her late game output for players with high mastery in all brackets, but especially pro-play.

lines.raw: Base damage reduced to 5 to 25 from 5 to 30.
Bonus AD ratio reduced to 20% bonus AD from 25%.

name: Ashe
rationale: Ashe is one of the premier marksmen in pro play at the moment, and we're seeing her output too much raw damage given her position as the highest utility marksman in the game.

lines.raw: Attack damage growth reduced to 3 from 3.5.

name: Cassiopeia
rationale: Our changes two patches ago to Cassiopeia have been pretty good directionally, with most players being proportionally less impacted from those adjustments than pros. We're taking another swing at her early resources because of how dominant she still is in early laning, making her work a little harder to create an advantage.

lines.raw: Base health reduced to 610 from 630.
Base mana reduced to 450 from 480.

name: Diana
rationale: While Diana's assassin build shines, her bruiser builds tend to be lagging a good bit behind. We want to inject a bit more power into that playstyle.

lines.raw: Shield bonus health ratio increased to 14% bonus health from 11%.

name: K'Sante
rationale: Warding off this warden from being as reliable as a blind pick in coordinated play - hurting early mana and consistent W damage reduction, which should be skewed for elite audiences.

lines.raw: Mana cost increased to 45 to 65 from 40 to 60.
Damage reduction reduced to 25% from 30%.
All Out damage reduction reduced to 70% from 75%.

name: Kennen
rationale: Stacking the odds a bit more in his favor with his signature spell (in Riftbound) and offsetting Rocketbelt changes that he'll be a bit less excited about.

lines.raw: Bonus attack speed increased to 50 to 90% from 40 to 80%.

name: Kindred
rationale: Kindred is currently a bit weak, so we're giving them buffs in areas that won't make them much more overwhelming in early invades. Optimistically, they'd also make a pretty unique addition to the meta.

lines.raw: Monster damage increased to 165% from 150%.

lines.attribute: Can no longer target small monsters.
lines.raw: Removed: Can no longer target small monsters.
Slow duration increased to 1.5 seconds from 1.

name: Lillia
rationale: Last patch we looked to inject a bit more power into the deer, but didn't quite see the movement we were looking for. We believe there is a bit more room for her to really prance around various levels of play so we are following up with another buff that'll really help her shine.

lines.raw: Sleep duration increased to 2.5 to 3 seconds from 2.5 at all ranks.

name: Lucian
rationale: Last patch's adjustment to help normalize mid and bot performance ended up landing as a nerf for bot lane, so we're following up with a buff to make up for the lost power.

lines.raw: Attack damage growth increased to 2.9 from 2.5.

name: Mordekaiser
rationale: Windows between Mordekaiser's ultimates make it hard to keep up with the pace of much of his opposition. His bread and butter (Q) can also feel less impactful as the pace of the game increases, so we think it can do more damage later on.

lines.raw: Base damage increased to 0 to 63 from 0 to 45.
Cooldown reduced to 120 to 100 seconds from 140 to 100.

name: Neeko
rationale: Rocketbelt's adjustment this patch will probably land as a small nerf for Neeko, so we're giving her some minor compensation

lines.raw: Base damage increased to 80 to 220 from 70 to 210.
Empowered root duration increased to 2 to 3 seconds from 1.8 to 3.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where the VFX and actual hitbox become misplaced if she casts it before the ball reaches a fast-moving ally.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where the VFX and actual hitbox become misplaced if she casts it before the ball reaches a fast-moving ally.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where the ability fails to cancel enemy teleports.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where the ability fails to cancel enemy teleports.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where it did not block damage from Double Up.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where it did not block damage from Double Up.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where it did not block Zenith Blade.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where it did not block Zenith Blade.

name: Smolder
rationale: Smolder has lost quite a bit of power over the last few patches, with the Cleaver ranged nerf and bot lane meta changes disfavoring him significantly. We're further encouraging crit builds to bring his bruiser and full crit builds closer in power.

lines.attribute: Super Scorcher Breath base critical strike chance scaling
lines.raw: Super Scorcher Breath base critical strike chance scaling increased to 25 to 60% from 25 to 55%.
Infinity Edge scaling increased to 0 to 10.5% from 0 to 9%.

lines.attribute: Flap, Flap, Flap bonus magic damage
lines.raw: Flap, Flap, Flap bonus magic damage increased to 8 to 14% from 8 to 12.8%.
Infinity Edge scaling increased to 0 to 1.8% from 0 to 1.44%.
Base heal increased to 100 to 250 from 100 to 170.
Heal bonus AD ratio increased to 75% bonus AD from 50%.

name: Swain
rationale: We're giving Swain mid a moderate buff this patch while also making an adjustment that should help normalize his mid and bot lane performance.

lines.raw: Base magic resistance increased to 34 from 31.
Base armor reduced to 23 from 25.
Base damage increased to 70 to 250 from 70 to 210.
Cooldown reduced to 20 to 16 seconds from 22 to 18.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where Depth Charge could fizzle after Sylas lost vision of the target.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where Depth Charge could fizzle after Sylas lost vision of the target.

name: Tahm Kench
rationale: As one of the tank supports with the lowest health regen, and many health scaling values on his abilities, Tahm Kench lost out on the recent adjustments to the support item. We're giving him compensation for that.

lines.raw: Base healing increased to 10 to 50 from 10 to 30.

name: Vayne
rationale: Vayne has settled into a fairly weak spot, and while we still aren't totally happy with her top vs bot skew, we're getting closer. We're adjusting her base stats to help in bot where she needs to weather harass, and reverting a mana cost to her Q that simply felt way too bad.

lines.raw: Base health regeneration increased to 5.5 from 4.
Health regeneration growth reduced to 0.4 from 0.5.
Mana cost reduced to 30 at all ranks from 46 to 30.

lines.attribute: Fixed a bug where it went completely on cooldown if the first attack was dodged.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where it went completely on cooldown if the first attack was dodged.

name: Yunara
rationale: Yunara is the leading candidate for "handshake hyperscaler do nothing" and we want to avoid that becoming the dominant meta, especially heading into worlds.

lines.raw: Passive base damage reduced to 3 to 23 from 5 to 25.
Active base damage reduced to 3 to 23 from 5 to 25.

lines.attribute: Slow no longer stacks with other slows.
lines.raw: Removed: Slow no longer stacks with other slows.

lines.attribute: Slow no longer stacks with other slows.
lines.raw: Removed: Slow no longer stacks with other slows.

lines.attribute: Immolate aura range now always properly scale with bonus size.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Immolate aura range now always properly scale with bonus size.

name: Experimental Hexplate
rationale:
We've been fairly unhappy with how this item has played out for ranged users, especially as a first rush in top lane where it makes them too resilient to burst and too lethal during all ins.
Rocketbelt continues to be used a bit too much as an escape compared to a risky engage tool, so we are pulling back on its generic value in favor of emphasizing aggressive action with it, especially for AP Bruisers who rely on it for all ins.
This item was slightly overbuffed, so pulling back on that a bit.
Our recent systemic buff-bar clarity work moved a lot of numbers from buffs onto items. These numbers began terrorizing your scoreboards (thanks, Death's Dance). The scoreboard should show strategically relevant information, not noisy in-the-moment combat state, and we're hiding most item numbers on the scoreboard to reflect this principle. Strategically relevant item numbers, like Tear of the Goddess items and Mejai's Soulstealer, remain on the scoreboard icons.

lines.attribute: Overdrive bonus attack speed for ranged champions
lines.raw: Overdrive bonus attack speed for ranged champions reduced to 25% from 35%.

lines.attribute: Overdrive bonus movement speed for ranged champions
lines.raw: Overdrive bonus movement speed for ranged champions reduced to 10% from 14%.
Ability haste reduced to 10 from 20.
Supersonic base damage increased to 135 from 100.
Supersonic AP ratio increased to 15% AP from 10% AP.

lines.attribute: Immolate aura range now always properly scale with bonus size.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Immolate aura range now always properly scale with bonus size.
Wind's Fury AD ratio reduced to 60% AD from 65% AD.

lines.attribute: Immolate aura range now always properly scale with bonus size.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Immolate aura range now always properly scale with bonus size.

name: Azir
rationale: We've kept the Emperor of the Sands’ mana pool pretty dry to make sure he needs to use soldier attacks properly for lane control early instead of just spamming [Q] Conquering Sands, but this is overly restrictive now that there are strong rank up incentives on his [W] Arise! We’re buffing his Mana Growth so he can more freely use his abilities to contest lane.

lines.raw: Mana growth increased to 50 from 40.

lines.attribute: Updated SFX to use the base skin's ult SFX when playing against her to improve clarity.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Updated SFX to use the base skin's ult SFX when playing against her to improve clarity.

name: Caitlyn
rationale: Caitlyn’s been at a very high pick and ban rate for most players for months now despite adjustments to other marksmen and the bot meta, so it's time to nerf her. We have felt that her late-game scaling has been too strong for a while now, so we’re moving some of her power from her eyepopping full build headshots into her early game Q damage to rebalance her power curve.

lines.raw: AD ratio reduced to 60 to 80% AD from 60 to 100% AD.
Critical strike chance ratio reduced to 0 to 80% from 0 to 100%.

lines.attribute: Infinity Edge critical strike chance ratio
lines.raw: Infinity Edge critical strike chance ratio reduced to 0 to 24% from 0 to 30%.
Base damage increased to 50 to 230 from 50 to 210.

name: Darius
rationale: Darius has moved a bit too far away from being a persistently durable damage threat that needs to be kited to more of a one shot combo playstyle. Since he has some room for power, we’re giving him a slight boost so he can swing that axe more often in sustained fights.

lines.raw: Cooldown reduced to 9 to 4 seconds from 9 to 5.

name: Jinx
rationale: Like her best friend Caitlyn, Jinx has been similarly dominant in the meta, even with the Hurricane nerf last patch. We’re slowing her roll to make it a tad harder to get her snowballing.

lines.raw: Base health reduced to 610 from 630.
Attack damage growth reduced to 3 from 3.25.

lines.attribute: Updated SFX to use the base skin's ult SFX when playing against him to improve clarity.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: Updated SFX to use the base skin's ult SFX when playing against him to improve clarity.

name: Lee Sin
rationale: Lee Sin has continued to be extremely popular since his adjustments to how his [W] Safeguard cooldown works with allies. While we like the extra flexibility that has given him, it's a bit too much power, so we’re nerfing the cooldown a bit along with a minor bug fix to how his E reveal works against invisible enemies and another small nerf to his [R] Dragon's Rage damage.

lines.raw: Cooldown increased to 8 seconds from 7.

lines.attribute: No longer reveals invisible enemies if they stealth after being hit by the ability.
lines.raw: Bug Fix: No longer reveals invisible enemies if they stealth after being hit by the ability.
Base damage reduced to 150 to 550 from 175 to 625.

name: Locke
rationale: Locke’s been out for long enough now that we have a better picture of where he’s overly excelling and where he’s falling a bit short. Some of those areas are his extremely generous mana tuning and ability to shrug off harass, and we’re also refining his power curve by improving his scaling damage slightly, because he falls off a bit too fast if he’s not able to close out games early.

lines.raw: Mana growth reduced to 60 from 70.

lines.attribute: Cooldown and mana refund per unused charge
lines.raw: Cooldown and mana refund per unused charge changed to 10 to 40% from 20 to 35%.
Mana cost increased to 60 to 80 from 50 to 70.
Grey Health store reduced to 20 to 200 from 40 to 200.

name: Miss Fortune
rationale: Miss Fortune has been in a relatively decent place throughout the year, but with the Hubris nerf this patch, we’re looking to compensate with a couple buffs to her damage output.

name: Nidalee
rationale: Our favorite huntress has been sitting at an extremely high winrate in high skill brackets, toeing the line into overpowered territory for some time now, even if she's not currently meta. Now that we’re bringing down the power of some other powerful meta junglers like Lee Sin, we’re giving Nidalee a minor nerf to prevent her from getting out of paw.

name: Nunu
rationale: The boy and his yeti lost some power when we nerfed Hextech Rocketbelt earlier this year so that ranged mages weren't just buying it for a dash to safety, so we’re restoring some of that damage elsewhere.

lines.raw: Maximum base damage increased to 750 to 1450 from 625 to 1275.

name: Orianna
rationale: We’re tapping up Orianna’s scalings to help her chunk a bit harder with her bread-and-butter combo in the late game without giving too much additional power to her laning phase.

lines.raw: AP ratio increased to 60% AP from 55% AP.

name: Qiyana
rationale: Damage on Qiyana's Q turned out to be a lot more impactful than we anticipated, so we’re partially reverting the buff we gave her back in 26.17.

name: Rammus
rationale: While Nidalee's winrate has been borderline overpowered in the high skill levels, Rammus has been rolling over pretty much everyone else, so he’s getting a light nerf too, ok?

name: Ryze
rationale: After the significantly early game nerfs to Ryze in 26.19, he hasn't been rewarded enough for succeeding when he does scale, so we’re buffing that.

name: Sion
rationale: Our favorite unstoppable juggernaut is looking rather stoppable in recent patches. We’re giving him some buffs to his baseline durability and rewarding him when he succeeds at using his ult to GET IN THERE rather than run away.

name: Taliyah
rationale: Taliyah is one of a handful of mage junglers, and we think she can be better supported for meta diversity. We’re buffing her [E] Unraveled Earth damage to make it more satisfying to land her CC combo.

lines.raw: Initial base damage increased to 70 to 250 from 60 to 240.
Initial AP ratio increased to 70% AP from 60% AP.
Detonation base damage increased to 30 to 90 from 25 to 85.

name: Taric
rationale: We're smoothing out some of the rough edges in Taric’s kit to allow him to shine a bit more. Way back in the day, Taric’s W was adjusted to combat the popular Master Yi + Taric funnel strats. A consequence of this was that his spells would fizzle if they were cast at the same time that his bound ally became untargetable. We believe this harsh restriction to how his abilities function is no longer necessary given the existence of Role Quests, so we're partially reverting this change so that spells now work on untargetable allies, though we are still keeping an existing exemption on [E] Dazzle for champions that disappear on screen because the gameplay is too unclear (sorry, Master Yi).

name: Tristana
rationale: Tristana’s early laning has devolved a bit into "Level 1 press [Q] and just auto attack to take complete control of the lane", which is a pretty low gameplay and off flavor way for her to succeed. We’re hitting her early [Q] attack speed so she’ll have to work a bit harder before jumping on her foes.

lines.raw: Bonus attack speed reduced to 40 to 120% from 60 to 120%.

name: Twisted Fate
rationale: Alongside the Taric QoL changes, we’re giving Twisted Fate’s R the same treatment so he can reveal champs even if they’re untargetable at the time of activation.

lines.raw: New Effect: Now reveals untargetable units.

name: Varus
rationale: In this set of changes, we’re mainly looking to snipe top lane Varus, where he tends to max W, unlike the more common Q max in bot. This won't bring his [Q] Piercing Arrow back up to prior Lethality Varus levels of power, but we believe it will help a lot with our ability to tune him for bot lane. As a maxed ability, it also offers more gameplay to Varus and his opponents to interact with than some more passive damage on W.

name: Vel'Koz
rationale: Vel’Koz has been a fairly quiet pick this year, having little presence or meta impact in mid and support. We’re looking to give him a little bit of help by rewarding him for landing his combos.

lines.raw: Base damage increased to 35 to 205 from 35 to 180.
AP ratio increased to 65% AP from 60% AP.

name: Viktor
rationale: It’s time for the Glorious…Devolution. It seems Viktor has evolved past the point of exploitable weaknesses, so we’re opening that up a bit by making him slightly more vulnerable in early game skirmishes and across the board.

lines.raw: Base movement speed reduced to 330 from 335.
Base shield reduced to 30 to 130 from 40 to 140.
Shield AP ratio reduced to 20% AP from 25% AP.
Shield duration reduced to 2 seconds from 2.5.

name: Wukong
rationale: Like Lee and Qiyana, Wukong has been a meta staple whirlwind of a force in the jungle for a while now. We’re looking to tap down his strength in the jungle while compensating for lane Wukong.

lines.raw: Base health regeneration increased to 5.5 from 3.5.
Bonus armor reduced to 4.5 to 10 from 6 to 10.

name: Xin Zhao
rationale: Following Sundered Sky's nerfs, we feel like Xin Zhao has room for buffs to both his AD Bruiser and AS focused builds, so we’re helping out his scalings.

lines.raw: Bonus AD ratio increased to 45% bonus AD from 40%.
Attack speed ratio increased to 1% per 4% bonus AS from 1% per 5% bonus AS.

name: Yone
rationale: The last changes to Yone successfully got him to start considering crit in his first item purchases, but also put him at a somewhat unsustainable power level. We are giving him a moderate nerf to bring him down a bit.

lines.raw: AD ratio reduced to 105% AD from 110% AD.

lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where she can get a 1000 damage Smite from a minion drop earlier than expected.

name: Zyra
rationale: Like Vel'koz, Zyra has had relatively little impact in the meta as tanks and enchanter supports have reigned supreme. We’re giving Zyra a greener thumb this patch to help her combat the forces trampling over her plants.

lines.raw: Recharge time reduced to 16 to 10 seconds from 18 to 10.

name: Bastionbreaker
rationale:
Bastion Breaker was buffed into being a bit of a generic stat stick in order to give it a proper swing in the meta. Now, we’re nerfing that generic power with a QoL improvement to keep it a satisfying item in its niche.
Dawncore is the enchanter capstone that isn’t, and currently only Soraka picks it up. Even when other supports get to full build, they often prefer other purchases. We’re buffing its AP value to make it less purely bound to Healing and Shielding.
The greaves are overperforming for marksmen, even when getting very few stacks, so we’re hitting it with a nerf to its cost to delay early acquisitions from getting too much value.
While Hubris has been a bit weak for melee champions, it’s clearly been overperforming for ranged users. We’re delineating between the two now to encourage melees and disincentivize ranged users from building it.

name: Aurelion Sol
rationale: The majority of Aurelion Sol players have made it pretty clear that they would much rather rank up his Singularity (E) second over his Astral Flight (W) even though it’s a much weaker second max. We agree that his (E) is a very cool signature spell, so we’re giving him a buff there to help make doing the intuitive fun thing the right thing.

name: Corki
rationale: We were cautious about Corki’s power level going into Worlds, but now (like Azir and Orianna), he has some more space to be better for everyone.

lines.raw: Base damage increased to 100 to 280 from 90 to 250.
Bonus AD ratio increased to 90% bonus AD from 85%.

name: Kayle
rationale: We've seen Kayle's relevance decrease steadily from earlier this year as the game’s moved past the top lane shake up from role quests. We’re giving her a small bump to help out her early laning since we believe that top lane could use some more scaling options.

lines.raw: Cooldown reduced to 10 to 8 seconds from 12 to 8.
Cooldown reduced to 140 to 80 seconds from 160 to 80.

name: Locke
rationale: While Locke's performance in general is within reason, he's proven to be a much deeper champion than we initially expected and players who have reached that level of Locke play have shown him to still be clearly too strong, especially early game.

lines.raw: Stack base damage reduced to 15 to 43 from 18 to 50.
Duration reduced to 5 seconds from 6.

name: Maokai
rationale: Maokai has remained a very still tree this year, and has been almost entirely stuck in support. We’re buffing him in a way that helps out his top and jungle more.

name: Mel
rationale: This patch, Mel is getting a midscope adjustment. You can read more about it here. For the spark notes version, she is having some power moved from early game to scaling, her W is being reworked into an Area-of-Effect missile destruction that retaliates rather than reflects effects, and her Q and R are getting adjustments to lower their cooldowns later on in the game so she can stack her passive to ever higher amounts.

rationale: After a series of nerfs earlier this year, Naafiri has largely fallen out of mid lane entirely and has been pretty mediocre in the jungle. We’re giving her a buff that should primarily help out her mid, bringing her role power closer to parity.

name: Rumble
rationale: Similar to Corki, Rumble was tuned for pro play. This change should help out the average rumble a bit more than pros when they catch back up to the patch cycle.

lines.raw: AP ratio per second increased to 40% AP from 35% AP.

name: Shen
rationale: Along with Maokai, Shen jungle has been pushed too far out of the meta. We were watching to see if some of the previous patches’ changes to help jungle tanks would bring him back up, but now we’re confident we can just buff him.

lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where the SFX was not audible in Spectator Mode.

name: Smolder
rationale: Our buffs a few patches ago landed a bit softer than we expected, but he’s ended up with a good balance between his Crit and Caster builds, so we’re giving him a more generic buff this time. We also expect the Doran’s Bow nerf in this patch to help him out a bit.

lines.raw: Base explosion damage increased to 25 to 125 from 10 to 110.

name: Thresh
rationale: Despite our prior nerf, Thresh has remained at the very top of the support pecking order for top tier players, so it’s time for another.

Base damage reduced to 200 to 500 from 250 to 550.

lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where he may miss out on a jungle treat if he transforms into an enemy champion when it's granted.

name: Viktor
rationale: Last patch's nerf to Viktor hit him harder than we expected - but we are happy about the impact it had on his early game bullying, so we are buffing him back in scaling.

lines.raw: Health growth increased to 105 from 100.
Initial AP ratio increased to 60% AP from 50% AP.

name: Yasuo
rationale: We were on the fence last patch with whether Yasuo would also need a nerf like Yone, but he's also continued growing in winrate as players migrate to crit builds and banrate reflecting that so he's getting the same treatment.

lines.raw: AD ratio reduced to 100% AD from 105% AD.

name: Zaahen
rationale: Zaahen is living up to his scaling fantasies, but hasn’t had enough to do in lane. This should make his early scrapping and skirmishing much more satisfying.

lines.raw: Cooldown reduced to 8 to 6 seconds from 10 to 6.

name: Doran's Bow
rationale:
We’re nerfing Doran's Bow by a minor amount, as it’s settled into a spot that is slightly but clearly too strong, resulting in marksmen that we expect to be leaning towards Doran's Blade instead being almost purely Doran's Bow users.
Overlord's should be one of the premier juggernaut capstone items, but outside of Sett hasn't been able to carry enough power to justify greeding for. We are adjusting Overlords in a way that should be a net buff for most other users while hopefully not ballooning its power level too far on Sett, who benefits the most from the Retribution passive because of synergy with his Haymaker (W).

lines.raw: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where it would be inconsistent on Ekko.

name: Annie
rationale: Annie has been underperforming a bit for a while now for the average player, so we're looking to give a little more fire-power and also help support her burning Tibbers build.

name: Azir
rationale: Hello again, bird gang. We've been keeping an eye on Azir's performance as he shifts from PTA to Lethal Tempo usage. His buffs from 26.21 landed a little lower than expected, so we're giving him a little more love. Note that the attack range increase does not impact his attack range with soldiers—only when he's stuck with his own basic attacks!

On-hit and on-attack damage modifier increased to 67% from 50%.

name: Bard
rationale: Bard has been in a pretty weak state after pro focused nerfs earlier this year, and has stopped building AP entirely. So, we're giving him a little boost to his Q base damage and ratio.

lines.raw: Base damage increased to 80 to 260 from 80 to 240.
AP ratio increased to 100% AP from 80% AP.

name: Ezreal
rationale: Ezreal has been underperforming at most ranks this entire year, despite still being very meta in pro play. Now that we are in the post pro play season, we're giving him a few buffs to help him succeed more in your games at home.

rationale: Galio's been a bit weak lately, and we want to take the time to buff him, especially to help out his weaker AP bruiser-y builds rather than only helping his current heavy AP one.

lines.raw: Shield amount increased to 8 to 20% maximum health from 7.5 to 13.5%.

name: Gnar
rationale: Like Ezreal, Gnar may be a top pick for pros, but he hasn't been performing as well in the rest of skill brackets, so we're giving his throwing arm a buff to give him a helping hand.

name: K'Sante
rationale: K'Sante is another staple in pro play at Worlds, but he isn't nearly as performant for everyone else, especially in late game where he falls off a cliff unlike most tanks.

Base damage increased to 45 to 205 from 45 to 165.

name: LeBlanc
rationale: LeBlanc's damage is sitting a little too high, especially on her very dependable Q, so we're tamping down her scaling ratio to make her less oppressive, especially when snowballing.

lines.raw: AP ratio reduced to 35% AP from 40% AP.

name: Master Yi
rationale: We've been keeping an eye on Master Yi for a few patches as the buffs, his Q Cooldown Refund, QoL adjustments, and jungle meta changes have settled. We think he's still a bit strong, and are tapping him down in a way that should mostly impact his crit build which has become his dominant play style, rather than his on-hit.

lines.raw: AD ratio reduced to 60% AD from 70% AD.

name: Mel
rationale: Mel's rework has landed directionally as we hoped as a moderate buff without affecting her ban rate. She's still a bit weaker than a standard champion and could use a little more firepower, so we're giving a little more strength to her Q and W.

name: Syndra
rationale: Syndra's stun feels a bit too available, so we're making it both more costly and higher cooldown early. These changes are also designed to make sure we're not pushing her into further reliance on high haste builds, and curb the ability to avoid mana investment.

name: Vel'Koz
rationale: We made a small error in Vel'Koz's math. He is very displeased with us. This won't have any realistic impact on his power level.

lines.raw: Total base damage increased to 450 to 950 from 450 / 700 / 925.

name: Vi
rationale: Now that the pro season is over, we want to give Vi a little more strength to boost her numbers in the rest of the ladder.

lines.raw: Base damage increased to 10 to 110 from 10 to 90.

name: Voltaic Cyclosword
rationale: Voltaic has been a bit too dominant as both an all-in and a poke lethality item. All-inning power is of higher importance to assassin functionality than the raw poke it's providing, so we're tuning down its trigger damage.

lines.raw: Firmament damage reduced to 8% (melee) / 6% (ranged) of target's current health from 9% (melee) / 7% (ranged).
